inclusion_rule: Language or text decoding studies whose ledger names scalp EEG or MEG. The design compared is the use-time action that produces the decoded signal: perception (listening or reading), imagined or covert speech, evoked-potential spelling (P300/SSVEP speller), or executed motor text production (typing, handwriting). Boundary: keypresses used only as behavioural responses are not typing decoding; reviews are counted as pattern matches but cannot be deciding priors; versions of one study count once.
